answer: The gale schedule is applied in zenith and walnut reveals each instalment. A payout is split and thus 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3265 identities would post 2799 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
